newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AHREND BUYS GERMAN FIRM, SEES H1 NET UP.
newsitem.headline: AHREND BUYS GERMAN FIRM, SEES H1 NET UP.

text.p: Office equipment group Ahrend NV said on Tuesday it had agreed to buy Germany's Rheinische Papier-Zentrale Irley & Rathous GmbH (RPZ) on July 1.
It added it expected a clear rise in 1997 first-half net profits compared with the first half of 1996, despite provisions taken for closing non-profitable outlets outside the Netherlands.
Office equipment firm RPZ is market leader in the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia and has annual turnover of about 75 million guilders.
Ahrend said the acquisition fitted its strategy to expand in Germany.
"The takeover will be paid for by Ahrend in cash and will contribute to profits in the second half of 1997," the Dutch group said. It did not disclose further financial details of the transaction.
